SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS average_aCL_IgM
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e2
    WHERE e2.ID = p.ID
      AND e2.`ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL
      AND e2.`ANA Pattern` <> 'S'
)
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
ORDER BY average_aCL_IgM DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
